lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the branchial region, high-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately five vertical columns, with 3-4 spots per column positioned between the longitudinal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased luminance are visible, roughly coinciding with the vertical columns of high-intensity blobs and intersecting with horizontal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette displays approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered in the lower half of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density patterning of small high-luminance spots, which are more densely packed than those on the primary lateral flank.
